content: Aḥaz, ajeǧid n Yahuda
Deg useggʷas wiss sbeɛṭac n Faqaḥ, mmis n Ramalyahu, idweř Aḥaz, mmis n Yutam, d ajeǧid n Yahuda.
Aḥaz tuɣa ɣares ɛicrin n iseggʷusa umi idweř d ajeǧid. Netta iḥkem seṭṭac n iseggʷusa di Urcalim. Netta war iggi min iǧan nican di tiṭṭawin n SIDI, AREBBI nnes, am mammec igga babas Dawud.
Netta yuyur deg ibriden n ijeǧiden n Israil. Netta ijja ɛad mmis ad yuyur di tmessi am mammec marra jjɛayef n řegnus inni tuɣa iɛarren SIDI zzat i wudem n ayt n Israil.
Netta yiwyi-dd tiɣarṣa d tewhibin n řebxur x řegɛudi u x tewririn u sadu marra azɣar aziza.
Xas uca iffeɣ Raṣin, ajeǧid n Aram, d Faqaḥ, mmis n Ramalyahu, ajeǧid n Israil, immneɣ ak-d Urcalim. Nitni nnḍen i Aḥaz, maca war zemmaren ad xas ɣeřben.
Di řweqt nni yarra-dd Raṣin, ajeǧid n Aram, Ilat i Aram. Issuffeɣ ayt n Yahuda zi Ilat uca usin-dd ayt n Aram ɣar Ilat, qqimen zeddɣen din ař ass-a.
Aḥaz issekk ireqqasen i Tiɣlat-Filasir, ajeǧid n Accur, inna: “Necc d amsexxar nnec d mmic. Geɛɛed d tfekked ayi zeg ufus n ujeǧid n Aram d ujeǧid n Israil, inni xafi innqeřben.”
Aḥaz yiwi nnuqart d wureɣ i ittwafen di Taddart n SIDI u deg ixxamen n txubay n taddart n ujeǧid uca issekk aya am ict n terzeft i ujeǧid n Accur.
Ajeǧid n Accur isřa ɣares uca igeɛɛed ujeǧid n Accur ɣar Dimacq, iṭṭef i-tt. Netta indeh i-tt ɣar lmenfa ɣar Qir u inɣa Raṣin.

Ajeǧid Aḥaz iffeɣ ɣar Dimacq i umsagar ak-d Tiɣlat-Filasir, ajeǧid n Accur, uca iẓra ijj n uɛalṭar di Dimacq. Ajeǧid Aḥaz issekk ijj n umedya n uɛalṭar d tweṣṣaf nnes n řebni, qaɛ am mammec tuɣa ittxeṣṣa ad t ggen, ɣar ukehhan Uriya.
Xas uca ibna ukehhan Uriya aɛalṭar. Ɣar řweqt i di dd-iɛqeb ujeǧid Aḥaz zi Dimacq, aqa ibna t ukehhan Uriya am mammec marra min ɣares dd-issekk ujeǧid Aḥaz zi Dimacq.
Umi dd-yusa ujeǧid zi Dimacq, iẓra ujeǧid aɛalṭar uca iqarreb-dd ujeǧid ɣar uɛalṭar uca issbexxar xas tiɣarṣa.
Netta issbexxar taɣarṣt nnes d tewhibt nnes n řɣiǧet u iseyyeb xas tawhibt n useyyeb nnes. Issfarrɣeɣ uřa d idammen n tɣarṣa nnes n řehna x uɛalṭar.
Aɛalṭar n nnḥas nni ibedden zzat i wudem n SIDI, issmuṭṭiy t zeg uɣezdis n zzat n Taddart, zi jar uɛalṭar n jdid d Taddart n SIDI, ɣar uɣezdis n ccamal n uɛalṭar n jdid uca issars i-t dinni.

Řexdenni ajeǧid Aḥaz iweṣṣa akehhan Uriya, inna: “Sbexxar taɣarṣt n wecmaḍ n ṣṣbeḥ d tewhibt n řɣiǧet n tmeddit řa taɣarṣt n wecmaḍ n ujeǧid d tewhibt nnes n řɣiǧet d tɣarṣt n wecmaḍ di ṭṭweɛ n marra řgens n temmurt d tewhibin nsen n řɣiǧet d tewhibin nsen n useyyeb, u zeǧeɛ xas marra idammen n marra tiɣarṣa n wecmaḍ u n tɣarṣa nneɣni. Aɛalṭar n nnḥas ad yiři i nnec, ḥima ad dayes arzuɣ ɛad.
Akehhan Uriya igga am mammec marra s minzi iweṣṣa ujeǧid Aḥaz.
Ajeǧid Aḥaz iqess teřwiḥin i yeǧan x tkarrutin uca ikkes zzaysent tabanyut i xas iǧan. Ikkes uřa d tarimant n waman zeg ifunasen n nnḥas inni sadu nnes uca issars i-tt x ict n zzellij n weẓru.
Pasu n ssebt i tuɣa ibnan di Taddart, uřa d adaf n ujeǧid ɣar uɣezdis n barra ikkes i-ten zi Taddart n SIDI di ssibbet n ujeǧid n Accur.
Imezruyen iqqimen n Aḥaz d min igga, ma man aya marra war ittwazemmem ca deg wedlis n imezruyen n ijeǧiden n Yahuda?
Aḥaz igga ad yareyyeḥ jar řejdud nnes di tendint n Dawud. Mmis Ḥizqiya idweř d ajeǧid deg wemcan nnes.

footnotes.text: Iramiyyen- ixs ad yini ‘ayt n temmurt n Aram’.
